findings.failure: Thin original corner column can vanish from prospective full raster at a translated pose. The registered ray retains each ORIGINAL boundary sample, so comparing against an absent future column was an invalid oracle.
findings.correction: Retain its continuous lower-edge ray, verify bounds and phase; distinguish vanished future columns in test output, never discard original samples or change admission.

findings.failure: At a native real_t=float boundary tie, lower+.5 may fall one ULP below the actual current below-neighbour. Adding its frac to the actual row shifted q by almost an entire cell.
findings.correction: Use raw_q=lower+.5 when inside authoritative current row. If just outside, snap into that row at lower boundary or nextafter(upper,lower), limited to8*float_epsilon*max(1,abs(raw_q),abs(x)). Larger disagreement is invalid geometry and blocks capture. Record signed phase_adjustment per ray; never translate a whole row to copy a near-one fraction.
findings.reason: Restores intended equivalence to native current raster while keeping continuous vertical phase, rather than introducing another admission parameter.

findings.failure: Expanded matrix exposed near-axis float local-coordinate rounding, where ideal double OBB edges disagree with native raster membership over a thin column.
findings.correction: For admission phase only, model native float-rounded local comparisons using the midpoint between each half extent and its next representable float. Keep ideal geometric_lower separately for physical hover gaps; nonintersecting ideal columns are marked null, not fabricated contact. Retain bounded current-row tie snap. This matches the existing native raster convention rather than changing physics or candidate extent.
findings.qualification: Expanded angles, horizontal/vertical phases and native literal float membership differential before any primary acquisition.
